beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Before the great day, a messenger would come first — Elijah, the prophet, sent ahead.

timing.text: Before the great day, a messenger would come first — Elijah, the prophet, sent ahead.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:

timing.text: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the coming of the great and dreadful day of the LORD:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Listen to who is talking there. That is God himself, making a promise out loud: before the last great day arrives, I am sending Elijah back. Not an army. Not a warning shot.

timing.text: Listen to who is talking there.
That is God himself, making a promise out loud: before the last great day arrives, I am sending Elijah back.

beats.speaker: god
beats.text: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

timing.text: And he shall turn the heart of the fathers to the children, and the heart of the children to their fathers, lest I come and smite the earth with a curse.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: His work was not to thunder, but to mend.

timing.text: His work was not to thunder, but to mend.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: The same spirit would later rest on John, preparing the way.

timing.text: The same spirit would later rest on John, preparing the way.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: So that when the Lord came, families would be ready.

timing.text: So that when the Lord came, families would be ready.

card.text: He cares about your family. Let the healing start with your own heart.
